issues.display_title: Issue #538: implement: BETA_MODE gating for the dashboard rail (beta panel + upgrade link)
issues.main_description_html:
Goal

Make the dashboard right rail follow the beta flag, so the same build serves both modes.

Right now the rail always shows the beta panel, and the "Upgrade to Pro" link is not in the code at all — it was removed when the beta panel went in.

Expected

Beta mode Dashboard rail shows
on beta panel only
off "Upgrade to Pro" link only

Scope

src/app/dashboard/page.tsx — right rail. Gate both items with the existing BetaOnly / PaidOnly helpers in src/components/beta/BetaGate.tsx. The upgrade link markup is in commit bc5759a.

Acceptance criteria

  • Beta off: upgrade link shows, beta panel gone.
  • Beta on: beta panel shows, no upgrade prompt.
  • Test covers both states.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

Note

The upgrade link points at /billing, which is gated separately in #539.

Goal

Tie the monetization routes to the beta flag, so /billing, /subscription, and /invoices disappear during beta and come back with the paid product.

Right now their layouts call notFound() unconditionally: the routes 404 in every mode, and switching the flag off means deleting three files by hand.

Expected

Beta mode Routes
on 404, including nested paths like /billing/success
off the paid pages, same as on development

Scope

src/app/billing/layout.tsx, src/app/subscription/layout.tsx, src/app/invoices/layout.tsx — gate the notFound() on the beta flag.

Because the routes stay 404 during beta, the beta notice written for them never renders. Remove it as dead code: src/components/beta/BetaMonetizationNotice.tsx and the BETA_MODE branches in the three page files.

Acceptance criteria

  • Beta on: all three routes 404, nested paths included.
  • Beta off: all three paid pages load, reachable from the sidebar and the dashboard upgrade link.
  • No unused monetization code left behind.
  • Test covers both states.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

Related

#538 — the upgrade link restored there points at /billing, so it depends on this.

issues.display_title: Issue #542: implement: beta feedback dialog opens correctly on every surface
issues.main_description_html:
Goal

The beta feedback dialog should open on every surface it is mounted on, on top
of whatever is behind it.

On the owner preview page it did not. Clicking the feedback icon appeared to do
nothing, because the dialog opened underneath the map instead of over it. The
same form works on dashboard, wizard, and editor, so the button looked broken
only in preview.

Expected

Surface Feedback dialog
Dashboard opens over the page, dimmed backdrop
Wizard generation result opens over the page, dimmed backdrop
Editor topbar opens over the editor
Owner preview topbar opens over the map
Public viewer (/v/[key], /embed/[key]) no feedback control at all

Scope

src/components/ui/dialog.tsx — the shared dialog sits lower in the stack than
the preview map and the editor topbar, so anything opened over those surfaces is
hidden. Raise it to the layer the rest of the app already assumes modals live
on: the collaboration dropdowns and select menus are positioned to clear it, and
PreviewModal sits there too, having forked this component to escape the same
problem.

Worth a pass over the other dialogs in editor and preview afterwards, since they
all move up together.

Acceptance criteria

  • Feedback dialog opens over the map on the owner preview page, with a
    dimmed backdrop, and closes on outside click.
  • Feedback dialog still opens correctly on dashboard, wizard, and editor.
  • No feedback control appears on the public viewer or embed.
  • Other dialogs in editor and preview still stack correctly.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

Related

#521 — beta PRD.
#530 — beta UI/UX design task this dialog came from.

issues.display_title: Issue #544: Live page: connection lines default on via project setting in canvasData
issues.main_description_html:
From albug's Slack feedback (2026-08-04): the connection-lines toggle on the live map should be a project setting — "it should be from the project, as a setting, if I want it default on or not".

Description

The pano connection lines (from canvasData.panoLinks, #279) already render on preview/live via the bottom-right toggle button in src/components/editor/PreviewOverlay.tsx, but the initial state is hardcoded: useState(!live) — on in owner preview, off on live. There is no per-project control.

Make the default a project setting stored in canvasData:

  • Add a new property to CanvasData (e.g. showPanoConnections?: boolean) — absent/undefined must mean true (default on), so existing projects get connections visible on live without a resave.
  • Where the setting lives: the Edit Project Info modal (src/components/editor/EditFileModal.tsx) — add a switch row (e.g. "Show connection lines on live", default on) below the location section. The modal already reads useMapStore and has a handleSave; persist the new property into canvasData on Save. The preview/live toggle button in PreviewOverlay.tsx stays a session-local override and never writes anything.
  • Live (/v/[key]) and embed read the property for the toggle's initial on/off state. The visitor-facing toggle button keeps working as a local, non-persisted override.
  • Owner preview can keep its current always-on default or read the same setting — follow whatever reads cleanest, but live/embed must honor the saved setting.

Relevant code:

  • src/components/editor/PreviewOverlay.tsx:275 — showConnections initial state + toggle button (~line 496)
  • src/lib/map/panoConnections.ts — shared resolver (no change expected)
  • src/store/useMapStore.ts — CanvasData type

Acceptance Criteria

  • New canvasData property controls the live-page connection-lines default; missing property = on
  • Owner can change the setting from the project and it persists (saved in canvasData, survives reload)
  • Live /v/[key] and embed initialize the connection-lines toggle from the saved setting; visitor toggle still works as a session-local override
  • Existing projects (no property saved) show connection lines on live by default
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

Assigned to: Muhamad Rifky — Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #546: Multi-building: integrate design branch — building model, editor management UI, default-building migration (PRD #536)
issues.main_description_html:
PRD #536 / design #537, task 1 of 5. Design branch design/multi-building-projects (commit 8679f9b) delivers the building model + editor management UI — integrate it, don't reimplement.

Description

Integrate the design slice into a feature branch cut from development:

  • src/store/mapStore/buildingsSlice.ts — buildings state + selected building
  • src/components/editor/BuildingSelector.tsx, ManageBuildingsModal.tsx (add/rename/delete), EditorPanel integration
  • Level-list filtering per building (floorOptions.ts, lib/editor/levels.ts, add-level/useAddLevel.ts)
  • CanvasData building fields in useMapStore.types.ts

Stale-fork warning: the design branch forked before the beta-mode work merged (2026-08-05). git diff development shows beta files as deleted — that is fork lag, not real deletions. Merge development into the integration branch first and verify no beta/accountRoutes/feedback files get dropped.

On top of the integration, close the PRD §FS1–3 gaps the design slice does not cover:

  • Migration: older projects (no building data) open with one default building owning every existing level; save/load/reopen keeps working. Publish/live payloads unaffected until task 5.
  • Delete building cascades its levels; the app can never end up with zero usable buildings (guard the last one).
  • New level always attaches to the selected (or default) building; delete level detaches it.
  • Building data persists in canvasData through save → reload (autosave path).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Design-branch editor UI works on top of current development (beta work intact)
  • Old projects open with one default building holding all levels — no resave needed
  • Create/rename/delete building works; delete removes its levels after confirmation; last building cannot be deleted
  • Level list, add-level, delete-level, and level switching are scoped to the selected building
  • Building data survives save, reload, and reopen
  • Unit tests: migration (old project → default building), delete cascade, last-building guard, level attach
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

RESULT

Merged via PR #551 (commit 9b99baa on development).

  • Integrated design/multi-building-projects — zero conflicts, beta work intact.
  • Buildings now persist: Building records moved from ephemeral store state into canvasData.buildings; save/undo/publish/live carry them automatically, selection stays session-only. (Design slice kept them in memory — names were lost on reload.)
  • Old projects migrate for free via the implicit default building (levels without buildingId); no resave needed.
  • deleteBuilding refuses a cascade that would leave zero levels (R8) — "last building cannot be deleted" AC is implemented as this zero-level guard, since zero named buildings is a valid state in the implicit-default model.
  • buildFloorOptions falls back to the default building on a stale selection instead of emptying the level list.
  • New tests: src/store/__tests__/useMapStore-buildings.test.ts (9). Full suite 789 pass, lint + tsc clean.

Commit: 59adbca

issues.display_title: Issue #547: Map Mode: compact building list — select-only, level controls scoped to selected building (PRD #536)
issues.main_description_html:
PRD #536 / design #537, task 2 of 5. Depends on task 1 (building model + editor UI).

Description

Map Mode gets a compact building list (PRD §UI2 + §FS4):

  • Show the project's buildings in Map Mode; selecting one switches the active building.
  • Select-only: no add/rename/delete controls in Map Mode — management stays in editor mode (task 1's ManageBuildingsModal).
  • Level controls in Map Mode stay limited to the selected (or default) building; selecting a building picks a valid level inside it (reuse the task-1 scoping in floorOptions.ts / levels.ts).
  • Selected building is visually explicit; the list stays usable with many buildings (scroll, not overflow) and must not block key map interactions.
  • Design reference: #537 screenshots (Map Mode panel).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Building list visible in Map Mode, selected building clearly marked
  • Selecting a building updates the level list and picks a valid level in that building
  • No building management (add/rename/delete) reachable from Map Mode
  • List scrolls with many buildings and does not block map pan/zoom/selection
  • Unit test: level options scoped per selected building in Map Mode
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

RESULT

Merged via PR #552.

  • Building list in Map Mode was already delivered by the #546 design integration (EditorPanel Building section: select-only in Map Mode, manage gated to editor mode, searchable combobox scrolls with many buildings).
  • Gap closed here: selectBuilding re-points activeLevelId to the chosen building's highest floor when the current level is outside it (kept when already valid).
  • Scoping rule extracted to levelsInBuilding() in lib/editor/levels.ts, shared by floorOptions + the buildings slice — #549/#550 reuse it.
  • Tests: selection revalidation both directions. Suite 790 pass, lint + tsc clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #548: Map Mode: per-building placement — move/rotate/scale, persisted per building (PRD #536)
issues.main_description_html:
PRD #536 / design #537, task 3 of 5. Depends on task 1; pairs with task 2 (Map Mode).

Description

Per-building placement in Map Mode (PRD §UI3 + §FS5): move, rotate, and scale one selected building without affecting any other building.

  • Transforms are stored per building in canvasData and persist through save/reload.
  • Placement must not alter indoor geometry (walls/areas/points keep their local coordinates — the building transform is applied at render time).
  • Prior art: #525 floor alignment tools already implement per-floor transforms with Active/All Floors scope — reuse that transform pipeline (makeLevelPixelTransform in lib/map/geojson-utils.ts) rather than inventing a second one; a building transform composes over its levels' transforms.
  • Clear feedback while moving/rotating/scaling, and an explicit way to finish/exit placement (design reference #537).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Selected building can be moved, rotated, and scaled in Map Mode
  • Transforms save per building and survive save → reload
  • Other buildings and indoor room/wall shapes are untouched by one building's transform
  • Placement UI shows which building is being adjusted and how to exit placement
  • Unit tests: transform persists per building; transforming building A leaves building B's geometry byte-identical
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

RESULT

Merged via PR #553.

  • Building.mapTransform (LevelTransform shape, prior art #525) composes floor → building → project in makeLevelPixelTransform — single seam, all renderers covered, sibling buildings untouched. Inverse in lngLatToLevelPixel.
  • MapTransformControl "All floors" scope targets the selected building when buildings exist (label names the building); legacy no-buildings behavior unchanged. Active-floor nudge inverses the building frame too.
  • Pivot = building bbox center; persists in canvasData → autosave/undo/publish carry it.
  • Tests: src/lib/map/__tests__/buildingTransform.test.ts (isolation, default fallback, round-trip, regression). Suite 794 pass, lint + tsc clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #549: Outdoor mode: building outer shapes + auto zoom indoor↔outdoor (PRD #536)
issues.main_description_html:
PRD #536 / design #537, task 4 of 5. Depends on tasks 1–3.

Description

Outdoor mode + automatic zoom transitions (PRD §UI4–5 + §FS6–7):

  • Outdoor rendering: closed outer shape per building (derived from its levels' footprint), shown for all buildings. Indoor detail hidden: rooms, walls, labels, points, shapes, safety markers, panorama markers, directions. View-only — no editing in outdoor mode. Extend lib/map/layer-definitions.ts / useFloorPlanLayer.ts with the outdoor layer set.
  • Auto zoom: zooming out past a threshold switches to outdoor mode; zooming into a building selects it and switches to indoor mode for that building. No manual outdoor/indoor toggle this version. When the target building is ambiguous, keep the selected/default building.
  • Level selector updates naturally after a zoom-in selects a building (task 2 scoping).
  • Works in editor Map Mode first; preview/live wiring lands in task 5.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Outdoor mode shows closed outer shapes for all buildings, indoor detail fully hidden
  • Outdoor mode is view-only
  • Zoom out → outdoor mode; zoom into a building → that building selected, indoor mode, level list updated
  • No manual outdoor/indoor toggle
  • Transitions are stable (no flicker/loop at the threshold)
  • Unit tests: outdoor layer set hides indoor sources; zoom threshold selects the right building (or keeps default when ambiguous)
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

RESULT

Merged via PR #554.

  • Outdoor massing: outdoorGeoJson — closed extrusion per building (lowest level's areas, bbox fallback), stacked building height, symbol labels for named buildings. Separate floorplan-outdoor source; view-only (selection cleared, markers/labels unmounted).
  • Auto zoom with hysteresis (enter <15.5, exit >16.0); zoom-in picks the building under the camera via transformed footprints → selectBuilding (#547 lands on a valid floor); ambiguous keeps selection.
  • Silhouette = lowest level's area polygons — not a true multi-level union; // ponytail-grade ceiling documented in code, upgrade to polygon union if silhouettes disappoint.
  • Fixed #548 gap: canvasDataToGeoJson now applies the building record transform (walls/areas follow placement; previously only markers did).
  • Tests: outdoorMode.test.ts (5) + suite 799 pass, lint + tsc clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #550: Preview/live: multi-building + outdoor mode, management hidden, legacy links intact (PRD #536)
issues.main_description_html:
PRD #536 / design #537, task 5 of 5. Depends on tasks 1–4.

Description

Multi-building + outdoor mode on preview, live, and embed (PRD §UI6 + §FS8):

  • /preview/[projectId], /v/[key], /embed/[key] load building data from canvasData (PreviewOverlay.tsx is the shared viewer).
  • Outdoor mode + auto zoom behave the same as editor Map Mode (task 4).
  • Viewers can switch levels within the selected building; building management controls never render outside the editor.
  • Backward compatibility: older shared/published projects (no building data) keep working via the task-1 default-building migration — old /v/{key} links must not break, and publishing a migrated project must not change its public behavior.
  • Directions/search/markers on preview/live keep working scoped to the selected building's active level.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Preview, live, and embed load and render multi-building projects
  • Outdoor mode + zoom transitions work on all three surfaces
  • Level switching works within the selected building; no management controls on public surfaces
  • Old published/shared links (single default building) render exactly as before
  • Building data survives publish → live view
  • Unit tests: viewer building scoping; legacy payload (no buildings) renders via default building
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

RESULT

Merged via PR #555 — closes out PRD #536 (tasks #546–#550 all merged to development).

  • PreviewOverlay (shared /preview, /v/[key], /embed/[key]) wired with useAutoOutdoor + useOutdoorLayer: outdoor massing zoomed out, building auto-select + valid floor on zoom-in. View-only: info card + direction/search close, markers/labels unmount.
  • Buildings reach live payloads via canvasData (#546); building picker select-only (design); level switching scoped (buildFloorOptions); legacy payloads = single unlabeled massing, indoor behavior unchanged (asserted in outdoorMode tests).
  • No new PreviewOverlay render test — the pure seams (outdoorGeoJson legacy fallback, scoping, hysteresis, building-at-point) are covered in outdoorMode.test.ts/useMapStore-buildings.test.ts; a maplibre-in-jsdom render test would be brittle for no added signal.
  • Suite 799 pass, lint + tsc clean.
